prior_cycle_evidence.r6_public_result: Gemini accepted the r6 schema and produced author model results; five of six attempts across the first two groups were structurally rejected, with one first-group attempt structurally valid and Groq-audit accepted. The second group exhausted three structural attempts. Candidate scoring never started.
prior_cycle_evidence.r7_public_result: Adding more native schema fields caused Gemini HTTP 400 invalid_request before any author model result. Candidate scoring never started.
prior_cycle_evidence.decision: Return exactly to the accepted r6 native schema and change only deterministic structural observability.

construct_inheritance.rule: R8 authoring uses these public construct/release semantics byte-for-byte from the pinned r6 preregistration. Only cycle identity, prior-cycle evidence and safe structural diagnostic observability differ.

heldout_authoring.native_schema_rule: Use exactly the pinned r6 AUTHOR_SCHEMA; no native schema field, nesting, cardinality or type changes are permitted in r8.
heldout_authoring.acceptance_rule: Each structurally invalid model result consumes one attempt and is discarded. Each structurally valid attempt receives one independent Groq construct audit. First ACCEPT is retained. No rejected hidden payload is inspected, repaired, ranked or reused.
heldout_authoring.safe_observability: Only the preregistered reason code may be logged for a rejected structural attempt. Never log field values, hidden reference text, task text, expected content or raw model output.

release_rule: PASS only after a COMPLETE sanitized FULL report validates against this r8 preregistration, at least 34/36 base tasks pass, every family is at least 2/3, all six inherited repeated critical trials pass and zero inherited critical hard-fails occur. Otherwise REVISE or NOT_EXECUTABLE under the frozen protocol.
